description: Replacement of windows to front bays and central sliding windows using heritage profile slim box sashes, flood proof glazing with hand blown crown glazing. The remainder of the windows to be refurbished to a conservation standard as per the current planning approval. Replacement of existing 1960's window to the side elevation, with a new heritage profile sash window into the existing opening, garage cladding including listed building consent under P/2020/2803
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SPHS-PL-400 REVA, replacement window details, design and access statement, heritage statement and planning statement- received 27/08/2020
SPHS-PL-401 REVB, SPHS-PL-410 REVB, SPHS-PL-420 REVB, SPHS-PL-421 REVB, SPHS-PL-430 REVB, SPHS-PL-431 REVB, SPHS-PL-440 REVB, SPHS-PL-441 REVB and SPHS-PL-442 REVB- received 11/11/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
